reviews.title: Devs need to quit software development
reviews.text:
I have never in my life used an app that’s as buggy as this. Genuinely how do you screw this up so bad? Everybody involved in the dev of this app should be ashamed and needs to quit software development because they are laughably incompetent. If you make the mistake of interacting with a UI element I hope you have five minutes to spare because the game will freeze. Usually only remedied by a restart. Flowers regularly do not plant when the app is closed, wasting your hard earned petals. Step counts do not sync properly. My phone and watch will say I have 10k steps while Pikmin only records 7k. 

I’ve never stopped playing a game because of bugs but congratulations to this team. This app is actually completely unusable.

reviews.title: Pokemon Go clone—gets old fast.
reviews.text:
An advertisement influenced me for the first time in years, when I walked through the Seattle Westlake station and found large flyers for this game on every single wall. I downloaded the game and gave it a try. 

For my first couple days playing, Pikmin Bloom was cute and nostalgic. Around the fourth day, I realize nothing had really happened gameplay-wise and the novelty of the game had most certainly worn away. 

Graphics, gameplay, events, etc. are almost identical to what we experienced during the Pokemon Go COVID-19 craze. I’m a little shocked that this game was approved by Niantic leadership given that it really is just a clone of Pokemon Go, but with even fewer features.

reviews.title: Unplayable
reviews.text:
I want to enjoy this game—it has a really cute theme, and the music is really calming and nice. I’m operating on iPad though, and whenever I open something like the missions menu, I’m softlocked with a super-zoomed in screen that I can’t click out of. I thought I could ignore it, but when I reload the app, I keep being prompted to receive a golden seedling, which forces me into another inescapable menu. I hoped I could bypass this, but every single time, it gives me this same seedling.
I also hate how limited the character customization is. I guess I’ll need to just figure out how to fix my Nintendo account so that I can link my account, because so far, I’m barred from doing that, which seems ridiculous to me, but there’s probably some reason for why child accounts are prevented from having basic perms, I guess. Which is crazy since I gave the app my date of birth which indicates that indeed I am an adult but whatever

reviews.title: This game is a masterpiece.
reviews.text: Pikmin Bloom is one of my favorite games of all time. It essentially is like Pokemon Go, except you walk around to grow pikmin and you can level them up so they can wear little outfits or objects depending on where they came from. I’ve been playing for years and the game is incredibly addictive if you’re into Pikmin or just cute things in general. This game will have you walking around everyday and entice you to explore new areas you’ve never walked before or just get you some exercise. This game is a must play for pikmin fans and people who just want to walk around. Plus, the pikmin themselves, friends, and the other activities that surround you in game will keep you playing for a long long while.
